core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hadir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Present, attending, at hand”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hadir corresponds to the Arabic form حاضر (Arabic root ح ض ر (ḥ-ḍ-r); حاضر (ḥāḍir)). Its core sense is present, attending; one who is there. Hadir is Arabic حاضر (ḥāḍir) 'present, attending, at hand', the active participle of the root ح ض ر. The source gloss 'present, presence' is substantially correct, though its Arabic column gave هادِر (a different word). The source recorded it as feminine; the form is grammatically masculine and its documented name use is male.
